'''Ben Read''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 1999 Bristol tournament]] on 26 September 1999 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]], according to Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d58">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-02-bristol-connecticut-again-9-26-99d58/ bristol-connecticut-again-9-26-99], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 2 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-02-bristol-connecticut-again-9-26-99d58/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
